Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Update [D] Controller edits / agent access
      |   |-- Replace per-call exec commits with buffered mutations: reads and state-dependent calls flush pending edits; each flush makes one version, checkpoint, and undo step. Errors discard unflushed edits but retain earlier flushes; immediate mode remains available.
      |   |-- Show MappingDocumentController issuing and retaining revisions instead of calling DiagramService, while preserving semantic validation, layout, and anchor reconciliation. Headless proposals use domain commands and checkpoints.
      |   |-- Introduce MappingEditorRuntime as the mounted controller's editor driver: it projects shapes, owns live tldraw geometry and undo, and writes settled gestures back as semantic checkpoints. The controller owns the driver attachment; the runtime owns transient shape state.
      |   `-- Remove the obsolete outgoing [D] -> [G] content-service connection; reanchor the existing [D] -> [E] checkpoint connection after combining changes.
      `-- [2] Add: Mapping/tldraw runtime integration (N1)
          `-- Attach from the new MappingEditorRuntime / editor-driver component in [D]. Detail subscriptions, local anchors, shape projection, input and selection coordination, gesture settlement, and history using MappingEditorRuntime.ts:1-207, CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx:1-185, MappingEditorCanvas.tsx:1-173, LocalAnchorStore.ts:1-34, SelectionTools.ts:1-49, shapeProjection.ts:1-54, and selectionGesture.ts:1-71.

      `-- [1a] Update CanvasSession
